verdict.rationale: Importing data when switching tools is a fair question for a work-management product like monday.com, but the pack never documents an import or migration feature (e.g., from Trello, Asana, Jira, or a CSV/Excel file). The 2-way sync integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk) are ongoing-sync features, an adjacent capability rather than an import tool. The GraphQL API and SDKs are only building blocks a developer could use to build an importer. One community post mentions a team moving from Trello to monday.com but says nothing about how its data was brought over.
